Name: Jayes' NPC relationship tweaks
Author: JorkitJaccoon
Description:
[b][size=4]Big thank you to  [url=http://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194181751-mitsux0/]mitsux0[/url][/size][/b][b][size=4]﻿ for helping compile these. leave a comment If you find anything we missed[/size][/b]
[b]If you feel like this mod is detracting an integral part of their dynamic please simply don't install it, my work is primarily for my friends and I, and just posted in case it makes others happy as well. All changes can be turned on or off with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿

Note that they may still dance at the flower dance together if neither are asked, this is not something that's within my capabilities to change, however, their dialogue about it is altered.[/b]

[b]This mod edits both dialogue and cutscenes, doesn't add any additions lines, just replaces.[/b]

[size=3][i]List of Toggles:
﻿●[/i][/size]No Harvey X Maru
[size=3] ﻿ ﻿[b]○ [/b]Note: Same thing as my other mod just without individual toggles, if you only want to remove some, just disable this toggle and ﻿ ﻿use my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30024]No Harvey X Maru[/url] as well﻿

﻿●[/size]No Abigail X Sebastian

﻿●No Leah X Elliot

●﻿No Penny X Sam

﻿●No Alex X Haley

﻿●No Shane X Emily

﻿●No Marlon X Marnie

[size=3][i]Additional Toggles:
[/i]
[i]﻿●[/i]Clint isn't an incel
﻿ ﻿○ Note: Speaks for itself, but addresses dialogue with/about all women not just Emily. Cutscenes are the same but the dialogue is ﻿ ﻿changed to make it about struggling to socialize instead.

﻿●Caroline hasn't had an affair
﻿ ﻿﻿○ Note: Small dialogue edit that could have potentially alluded to an affair.

﻿●Vincent doesn't have a crush on Penny
[/size] ﻿ ﻿○ Note: Obviously this is not a reciprocated crush, and it's common for kids to say things like Vincent does, but I know it's awkward dealing with that ﻿ ﻿﻿as an adult in childcare.
